Subject: [Alert] Promo stacking signals — cluster of Datumlytics-related accounts

Marissa / Aditya —

Automated monitoring flagged an abnormal promo-credit pattern originating from three accounts that map to the same corporate domain (datumlytics.com) but different sign-up emails and overlapping payment metadata. We observed: repeated trial credit requests within 30 days, similar IP ranges, and identical billing name tokens. Attached is a snapshot (acct_cluster_snapshot.csv) showing account ids and timestamps.

Recommendation: hold manual credit grants until we validate ownership and intent. Pattern fits "credential stacking" where teams create multiple trial identities to bypass promo caps.

Thanks,
Fraud Ops (automated notification)
